translations.web: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
translations.bsb: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
translations.kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
translations.asv: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.
